scope: Read-only product review; edits restricted to independent test file and evidence logs. Temporary projects only; no original business data or production writes.

fixed_findings.finding: Shared agent credential forged operator decision with self-declared HTTP headers.
fixed_findings.fix_verified: A separate operator credential is required at server dispatch; shared agent token receives 403 and records no decision.

fixed_findings.finding: Changed preview launch configuration reused previous acceptance.
fixed_findings.fix_verified: Preview command is in configuration binding; prior technical/human acceptance becomes invalid.

fixed_findings.finding: Preview restart overwrote original raw log bytes.
fixed_findings.fix_verified: Restart creates a distinct log path; the previous full raw bytes remain unchanged.

fixed_findings.finding: Candidate submission ignored explicit ticket base.
fixed_findings.fix_verified: Explicit baseline mismatch receives 409 and creates no new candidate.

fixed_findings.finding: Another database connection closing the ticket during preparation was silently reopened by submission.
fixed_findings.fix_verified: Submission rechecks current readiness inside the write transaction; closed state survives and no candidate is inserted.

criteria_coverage.A1: Real HTTP tests compare item IDs for Chinese, Unicode casefold, English case, %, _, quotes and literal HTML-like query text.
criteria_coverage.A2: Real HTTP tests cover all/pending/completed intersection, empty outcomes and clearing to all; SQLite state unchanged on reads.
criteria_coverage.A3: Real HTTP tests cover URL persistence, refresh, restart, unknown states, duplicate fields, prefixed edit/cancel/toggle/create/redirect. Actual browser acceptance remains a separate required root-agent check.
criteria_coverage.A4: All existing 26 tests retained, plus nine filter tests. Coverage includes 200-character CRLF boundaries, original IDs and completion status, CSRF, escaping, DB failures/retry, restart and byte-identical SQLite reads. Original user three-record preservation must be verified separately against real main-data snapshot.

remaining_boundaries: Operator credential isolates remote shared-token clients; it is not proof of a human identity and cannot isolate another process with the same OS-user file access.
Synthetic verification/preview fixtures test state invalidation only; they are never evidence of actual product build, preview or business success.
No new blocking issue found in the reviewed final code.
